comment: Expectations live outside defects.js so nothing in the linter's input names the defect it is meant to find. This lists EVERY genuine defect in the fixture, not just one per rule. An incomplete truth file makes a sound rule look unusable: its correct answer on an unlabelled real defect is scored as a false positive.

expect.what: initSidebar reads the collapsed state once and never listens for another tab's change
initSidebar reads storage with no guard, so a throw leaves the toggle unwired
restoreSelection reads storage with no guard either, so a throw escapes the function
restoreSelection assumes the parsed value is an array of objects with .id
restoreSelection parses stored text with nothing catching a throw
recordDismissal promises the id is component-encoded; it is concatenated raw
recordDismissal writes one key per banner id and nothing removes them
rememberScroll writes one key per document with no eviction
persistSession puts bearer tokens in localStorage
loadConfig parses a network response with nothing catching a throw
markSeen writes a cookie with neither SameSite nor path
saveDraft encodes the name, loadDraft does not, so drafts are never found
saveDraft writes one key per field name and nothing removes them
loadDraft is the read side of the same mismatch, reported from its own unit
resetEverything calls clear(), erasing the host application's keys too
openCache opens without onupgradeneeded or an error path
